extras.zh: 官方来源互相矛盾：Explorer API 把 0xff35…2e67 叫 Vault Lock；Explorer 前端常量与后端迁移脚本把 0x4ed6…8675 叫 Vault Lock。两者都在部署交易 0x8dae0c83…8ef5 中（index 0 / 1），是不同二进制。本插件两个都匹配，未向维护方确认哪个是哪个。
extras.en: Official sources disagree: the Explorer API names 0xff35…2e67 Vault Lock, while the Explorer frontend constants and backend migration name 0x4ed6…8675 Vault Lock. Both come from deploy tx 0x8dae0c83…8ef5 (index 0 / 1) and are different binaries. This plugin matches both; which is which is unconfirmed with the maintainer.
